Answer · SSOJet cost by MAU (no SSO)

10k users: $0/mo on Free · 50k users: $0/mo on Free · 100k users: $0/mo on Free.

  • 1k users · no SSO: Free lists $0/mo: tie at $0 with 13 other plans.
  • 10k users · 1 SSO: Business at $79/mo ranks #11 of 25, $948/yr more than Auth0 Free (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection).

As of 2026-11-07, from 34 verified plan rows. SSO users: Amazon Cognito, Supabase Auth and Firebase Auth / Identity Platform bill SAML/OIDC per SSO user, not per connection (first 50 free, then $0.015 per SSO user a month). Their SSO results here assume 200 SSO users per connection (5 connections = 1,000 SSO users). See how 1,000 or 2,000 per connection changes the result or set your own. B2B: every SSO result assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection (members = its SSO users, 200 by default). Published org caps and fees are applied, e.g. Clerk’s $100/mo B2B Authentication add-on above 20 members or 100 orgs, Auth0 Free’s 5-org cap, Descope $1/tenant over 35; plans over a cap are left out. SSOJet SCIM / Directory Sync

  • Free: Not offered on this plan. No enterprise SSO or SCIM on Free. source · 2026-11-07
  • Business: Shared with SSO on one connection ladder: $79 (1–4), $72 (5–9), $65 (10–24), $55 (25–49), $47 (50–99) per connection (SSO + SCIM counted together). SSOJet pricing FAQ

How much does SSOJet cost at 10k, 50k and 100k users?

10k users: $0/mo on Free; 50k users: $0/mo on Free; 100k users: $0/mo on Free. Cheapest verified SSOJet plan, monthly USD list price, no SSO, from https://ssojet.com/pricing/ (checked 2026-11-07).

How does SSOJet count billable users?

SSOJet bills by connection: No per-user or per-MAU charge. Business bills each production SSO or SCIM link as one connection on a shared volume ladder; Free has unlimited users but no enterprise SSO/SCIM.

Does SSOJet charge for SCIM / Directory Sync?

Free: Not offered on this plan. Business: Shared with SSO on one connection ladder: $79 (1–4), $72 (5–9), $65 (10–24), $55 (25–49), $47 (50–99) per connection (SSO + SCIM counted together).
